mapper.select:
with query_point as ( select ST_SetSRID( ST_MakePoint( cast(#{longitude} as double precision), cast(#{latitude} as double precision) ), 4326 )::geography as point_geog )
select p.poi_id, p.name, p.source_category, p.source_subcategory, p.poi_type, ST_X(p.geom) as longitude, ST_Y(p.geom) as latitude, ST_Distance( p.geom::geography, query_point.point_geog ) as distance_meters from public.pois p cross join query_point where ST_DWithin( p.geom::geography, query_point.point_geog, cast(#{radiusMeters} as double precision) ) order by distance_meters, p.poi_id

with query_point as ( select ST_SetSRID( ST_MakePoint( cast(#{longitude} as double precision), cast(#{latitude} as double precision) ), 4326 )::geography as point_geog )
select count(*) as total_count, count(*) filter (where p.poi_type = 'medical') as medical_count, count(*) filter (where p.poi_type = 'education') as education_count, count(*) filter (where p.poi_type = 'shopping') as shopping_count, count(*) filter (where p.poi_type = 'dining') as dining_count, count(*) filter (where p.poi_type = 'leisure') as leisure_count, count(*) filter (where p.poi_type = 'transport') as transport_count from public.pois p cross join query_point where ST_DWithin( p.geom::geography, query_point.point_geog, cast(#{radiusMeters} as double precision) )
